headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on markets

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 17 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment during the last trading session.
Earlier in the week, foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices boosted market performance.
Strong Q2 earnings and FII buying drove mid-week equity gains.
PSU Bank stocks supported weekly index performance as top sectoral gainers.
whatHappening: In the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points while Nifty slipped lower.
Gift Nifty signaled a weak opening prior to Friday's market decline.
Over the full week, NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their rally for a third consecutive week.
Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 17 November.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices ended lower as inflation concerns weighed on sentiment, leading Sensex to drop 289 points. Despite Friday's decline, markets achieved a third consecutive week of gains overall, supported by strong PSU Bank performance and foreign fund inflows earlier in the week. Markets are closed today for the weekend.
